From 59dd36f41ea6a5c69c1f737125251df2ff8eb5ce Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2020 02:24:17 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] hwmon: (amd_energy) Missing platform_driver_unregister() on
 error in amd_energy_init()

Add the missing platform_driver_unregister() before return
from amd_energy_init() in the error handling case.

Fixes: 8abee9566b7e ("hwmon: Add amd_energy driver to report energy counters")
Reported-by: Hulk Robot <hulkci@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Acked-by: Naveen krishna Chatradhi <nchatrad@amd.com>
Reported-by: Hulk Robot <hulkci@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200527022417.105620-1-weiyongjun1@huawei.com
Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <linux@roeck-us.net>

diff --git a/drivers/hwmon/amd_energy.c b/drivers/hwmon/amd_energy.c
index bc8b643a37d5..e95b7426106e 100644
--- a/drivers/hwmon/amd_energy.c
+++ b/drivers/hwmon/amd_energy.c
@@ -379,8 +379,10 @@ static int __init amd_energy_init(void)
 		return ret;
 
 	amd_energy_platdev = platform_device_alloc(DRVNAME, 0);
-	if (!amd_energy_platdev)
+	if (!amd_energy_platdev) {
+		platform_driver_unregister(&amd_energy_driver);
 		return -ENOMEM;
+	}
 
 	ret = platform_device_add(amd_energy_platdev);
 	if (ret) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/hwmon/amd_energy.c`**
- Added a call to `platform_driver_unregister(&amd_energy_driver);` in the error handling case when `platform_device_alloc(DRVNAME, 0)` fails (i.e., when `amd_energy_platdev` is `NULL`).
- This addition ensures that the driver is properly unregistered if the allocation of the platform device fails, preventing potential resource leaks.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to error handling in the `amd_energy_init()` function. Specifically, it ensures that if the initialization process encounters an error after successfully registering the driver, the driver is unregistered to maintain system stability and resource integrity. This change is a direct fix to the issue reported in the commit message, which references a previous commit that added the `amd_energy` driver.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
ret = platform_driver_register(&amd_energy_driver);
amd_energy_platdev = platform_device_alloc(DRVNAME, 0);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because if the allocation of `amd_energy_platdev` fails (i.e., it returns NULL), the driver remains registered due to the absence of a call to `platform_driver_unregister()`. This can lead to resource leaks and instability since the driver is still active without a valid platform device.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
platform_driver_unregister(&amd_energy_driver);
```
Reason:
The fix involves adding a call to `platform_driver_unregister()` in the error handling path right after the check for `amd_energy_platdev`. This ensures that if the platform device allocation fails, the driver is unregistered, preventing resource leaks and maintaining system stability.
